payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover, a major aging mechanism in sodium-flow designs. An independent audit corrected the prototype’s cycle life to 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee. The cell’s gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg, while projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh. Its operating limit is a 4 °C floor, below which the thalliline dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.
